primary_endpoint: MASH improvement without worsening of liver fibrosis at 48 weeks.
efficacy_outcome: Primary endpoint occurred in 53% (41/78) with dapagliflozin vs 30% (23/76) with placebo (risk ratio 1.73, 95% CI 1.16–2.58; P=0.006).
safety_signal: Discontinuation because of adverse events occurred in 1% (1/78) with dapagliflozin and 3% (2/76) with placebo.
